subject: general
question: Who was the first Chief Election Commissioner of India?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Sukumar Sen.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sukumar Sen** was an **Indian civil servant** who was the** first Chief Election Commissioner of India,** serving from** 21 March 1950 to 19 December 1958.**
 
• The commission of India was framed in January 1950 to **control the general election in India** after independence.
 
• He was among the** first recipients** of the **civilian honour of ****Padma Bhushan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharaj Sri Nagendra Singh **was an Indian lawyer and administrator who work as President of the International Court of Justice from **1985 to 1988.****​**
 
• **R. V. S. Peri Sastri** was a former Chief Election Commissioner of India and worked from **1 January 1986.**** **
 
• **Tirunellai Narayana Iyer Seshan** was an Indian civil servant and bureaucrat.
